name: Objective-CMAS
description:
Objective-CMAS, the hot new kid on the block with a definitely-not-new base. Using the Objective-C Programming Language, it certainly seems like it would be the most outdated of the major implementations, but you'd be surprised. Objective-CMAS is by far the most advanced iteration of SIMAS yet, with innumerable improvements over its predecessors.
Additionally, Objective-CMAS is hand tuned with Manual Reference Counting, so you can rest assured that you are getting the best balance of stability and raw speed out of this SIMAS iteration.
